ink.$description: Ink — Primary text, all borders, nav link color, product card frame, massive hero wordmark — the structural color of the entire system

paper.$description: Paper — Page canvas, card backgrounds, image backgrounds, inverted text on dark controls

graphite.$description: Graphite — Muted secondary text, tertiary borders, inactive UI elements

helvmono.$description: Primary interface font — all body text, navigation links, product names, section labels, card metadata. The monospaced character set is the signature choice; it makes even navigation read like a technical catalog. A 14px size with 1.0–1.3 line-height creates a dense, label-like rhythm.

helvetica-bold.$description: Footer/legal micro-copy and secondary link text. The 12px size with 2.5 line-height signals fine-print territory.

apple-system.$description: Button labels and the dominant system fallback for interactive elements. The bold weight creates a single moment of typographic contrast against the 400-weight monospace body.
